Further the Register of Members and Share Transfer Books will remain closed from September 18, 2010 to September 25, 2010 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of AGM and for reckoning the entitlement of the shareholders for the payment of Final Dividend 2009-10 @ Rs. 16/- per share subject to approval at the AGM.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange vide Notes to Accounts in the Unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2010 (taken on record by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on July 27, 2010) regarding the Initial Public Offer (IPO) proceeds have been utilised as per objects of the Issue as stated in the Prospectus.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that vide Notes to Accounts in the audited financial results for the year ended March 31, 2010 (taken on record by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 26, 2010) regarding the Initial Public Offer (IPO) proceeds have been utilised as per objects of the Issue stated in the Prospectus.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its Meeting held on May 26, 2010 have recommended Final Dividend at the rate of Rs. 16.00 per Equity Share of Rs. 10 each amounting to Rs. 384.72 crore excluding dividend tax for the financial year 2009-10 has been recommended subject to approval of the member in the AGM. This is in addition to Interim Dividend at the rate of Rs. 18.00 per Equity Share amounting to Rs. 432.82 crore already paid. The total of interim and recommended dividend for the year is Rs. 34.00 per equity share amounting to Rs. 817.55 crore (excluding dividend tax).
Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that : " Shri Ashok Anand has ceased to be Director (HR&BD) pursuant to his superannuation from the services of the Company on 30.04.2010 ".

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that: "It is hereby notified about the: Grant of Navratna Status to OIL by Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas. Oil India Limited has been awarded with Navratna status from Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas (MOP&NG) vide Letter No. 23(3)/2005-GM-GL-100 dated April 20, 2010. This will bring OIL in to global giants, wherein various powers has been delegated to OIL Board that have comparative advantage and capacity to become global giants (presently known as Navratna)".

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that:"The Company will be publishing its Audited Financial Results for the year ended March 31, 2010 within 60 days from the close of the financial year 2009-2010 i.e. by May 30, 2010".

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company will be publishing its Audited Financial Results for the year ended March 31, 2010 within three months from the close of the financial year 2009 - 2010 i.e. by June 30, 2010. In view of the above, OIL will not publish its Unaudited Financial Results for the last quarter ending March 31, 2010 before April 30, 2010.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that in terms of the Orders from the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, GOI, Shri S.K. Srivastava has been relieved from the post of Director (Operations), Oil India Limited with effect from February 25, 2010 (A.O.H).

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange vide its letter dated February 11, 2010 regarding "OIL joins a multibillion dollar integrated oil project in Venezuela." Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the outcome of the Board meeting held on January 30, 2010 which is as follows: (1) February 11, 2010 has been fixed as the "Record Date" for payment of the Interim Dividend. (2) The payment of the Interim dividend shall start from February 15, 2010 onwards to the shareholders.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the company in their meeting held on January 30, 2010 have declared an interim dividend of Rs. 18 per share (i.e. 180%) to the shareholders of the Company for the financial year 2009-10.

Oil India Limited has informed the Exchange that Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas vide letter no. C-31014/2/2008-CA dated. September 07, 2009 conveyed the appointment of Shri S.K.Srivastava by the President of India as Director (Operations), Oil India Limited for a period of five years from the date of assumption of charge of the post or till the date of his superannuation or until further orders whichever is the earliest. Accordingly, Shri S.K.Srivastava assumed the charge as Director (Operations) of the Company on October 01, 2009.
